title: Tostones (Twice-Fried Green Plantains) with Mayoketchup
summary: Green plantain rounds fried until tender, pressed into discs, dipped in salted water and fried again until crisp, finished with salt and garlic powder and served with a cumin-spiked mayonnaise and ketchup dip.
equipment: large heavy pot or Dutch oven
2 baking trays lined with kitchen paper

ingredients.item: green (unripe) plantains, peeled and cut into 2.5 cm rounds
ingredients.note: about 700 g peeled; firm and fully green

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt, for the dipping water
neutral frying oil (sunflower, rapeseed or vegetable)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the dip
steps.text: Stir the mayonnaise, ketchup, cumin and 1/4 tsp garlic powder together and set aside. Stir 1 tsp salt into the water in a small bowl for dipping.

steps.title: First fry
steps.text: Heat the oil in the pot to 160 °C (about 3 cm deep). Fry the plantain rounds for 5-6 min, keeping the oil at 150-160 °C, until deep yellow and just starting to colour. Drain on paper and cool for 5 min. This gentle first fry cooks the starchy flesh through.

steps.title: Flatten and dip
steps.text: Press each piece into a 6 mm disc with the tostonera or the bottom of a glass. Heat the oil to 190 °C. Dip each disc into the salted water for 1-2 seconds, shake off the excess and lay on a rack. The quick dip seasons them and helps the edges puff and crisp.

steps.title: Second fry
steps.text: Fry in two batches for about 3 min, turning, until golden brown and crisp, bringing the oil back to 190 °C between batches. Drain, sprinkle with the remaining salt and garlic powder, and serve hot with the dip.

tips: Only fully green, firm plantains work; yellow ones turn soft and sweet.
To peel, cut off the ends, slit the skin lengthwise and prise it off with your thumb.
Never leave hot oil unattended; cool it completely before straining and storing.

Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Best eaten straight away. Flattened but not twice-fried discs keep at room temperature for 2 hours or frozen for 1 month; fry from frozen until golden. The dip keeps refrigerated for 3 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
